name: Mareshine

update.channel: GitHub releases (the app also checks for updates itself at start, setting SMS_UPDATE_CHECK)

assets.needs: Your own Super Mario Sunshine disc image, USA GMSE01 (a PAL disc goes in iso/pal).
assets.location: Imported into <data>/iso/, where <data> is /sdcard/Android/data/io.github.them3dium.mareshine/files by default or the folder in shared_prefs/sunshine.xml key data_dir.
assets.notes: An imported USA disc lands at <data>/iso/GMSE01.iso. The game boots in 16:9.

settings.in_app_menu: Launcher > Settings (Video presets Recommended/Low/Medium/High/Ultra, then Resolution, Picture, Effects, Graphics driver, Controls, Cheats, Mods, Achievements, Updates).
settings.summary: render_scale 0.5-4x (1.5 default), frame_rate 30/60/120, widescreen 16:9/16:10/20:9/21:9/off, HUD at edges or 4:3 area, draw distance 0.7-5x, MSAA, anisotropic, FXAA, shadows/reflections/water/shimmer toggles, copy write-back, ANGLE (Vulkan) alpha, cheats (god mode, infinite lives/FLUDD, speed, jump, moon jump, coins).

controls: SDL2 controller input with remapping (ControllerSettingsActivity, stored in settings.txt), on-screen touch buttons (Classic or GameCube style), optional gyro aiming. Select opens the quick menu.
display: Single screen, widescreen by camera (not stretched), up to 120 fps. No second-display code found in the APK.
saves: <data>/saves/ (memory card card-a and the shader cache). Save states via SaveStatesActivity; optional Wi-Fi sync between devices.
notes: v2.2.0 released 2026-11-26 ('Winter Update'). Release APKs share one signer (ad9c2bb0...), so updates install over. Mods (Eclipse, Sunburn, example) and achievements are built in. Fork of jbcgames/sms-android, built from the doldecomp/sms decompilation with the chasem PC port (assets/licenses).
verified: Device: dumpsys, data dirs, GMSE01 header bytes. APK: jadx of DataDir, Settings (DEFAULTS), SettingsActivity (every Choice/Toggle). Web: GitHub API (repo, license, parent, releases), Recompa index. Not checked: rvz import, in-game behaviour.
